source.snippet: I would pay for an app that allows me to explore any city in the world in a similar matter [as a video-game-style city explorer].

problem_statement: Travelers and urban explorers want an immersive, game-like interface to virtually explore cities around the world before or during travel, but no product combines street-level spatial navigation with the engagement of a video game.
target_segment: Frequent international travelers, remote workers planning relocation, and travel enthusiasts aged 25–45
notes: Explicit 'I would pay for' statement on HN is a direct buyer signal. Single data point keeps strength at 2, but the statement is unambiguous. Market exists: Google Street View, Airbnb Experiences, and travel apps don't scratch this itch. A solo operator could build a curated version for a single city vertical first.
